prompt_en: Vertical medium-close documentary photograph in a quiet afternoon cafe. One explicitly adult original human nekomimi barista wears a covered practical apron and performs a careful latte pour. Her baseline is a steady practiced pour, eyes fixed on the cup and wrist relaxed. Freeze the exact half-second during the uninterrupted pour, just as a small metal timer's red indicator lights and before her face or wrist can recover. Both compact living cat ears have snapped toward the timer while her eyes are only beginning to follow; her pouring wrist freezes, the thin milk stream kinks visibly, and her lips press into a serious line as she tries to maintain composure. The kinked stream is currently forming one tiny off-center curl in an otherwise plain foam rosette. The ordinary metal timer, its physical red indicator, the milk stream, and the off-center curl remain visible without drawn sound lines or reaction marks. Her clearly adult human face, covered barista apron, bare human forearms, five-fingered human hands, and short natural human nails remain readable. Only the compact cat ears emerge through the hairline with millimeter-scale transitional fur at their organic roots; there is no muzzle, tail, paw anatomy, or fur on the arms. A subtle feline reflective catchlight and faint natural whisker-shadow skin marks remain secondary to her human face. Her face, ear direction, pouring hand, timer, milk stream, and latte cup share one tight focal plane. Soft window light and cafe color bounce catch the steam, cup rim, and creased apron; 35mm natural perspective, foreground saucer blur, gentle focus falloff, and realistic contact shadows. Nonsexual everyday observation, no costume-headband look and no glamour pose.
